domainShiftAudit.combinedRunLocalClusterContract: C# labels below exist only in the independently fitted Combined run and are not aligned to Group 1 or Group 2 Rescanned C# labels.

inferenceBackendProvenance.confounding: Group 1 CUDA versus Group 2 Rescanned MPS/bfloat16 processing is cohort-linked. Device values are recoverable from local configs, but runtime tensor-dtype equivalence is not logged; precision remains declared pending verification.

domainShiftAudit.interpretation: High separability indicates cohort-linked representation shift, but cohort, cell line, processing batch and inference backend are fully confounded; it cannot identify a cause.

leaveOneMouseOutCohortClassifier.heldOutScoring: tile predictions summarized once per held-out mouse; eight mouse scores averaged equally
leaveOneMouseOutCohortClassifier.trainingWeighting: equal cohort mass and equal mouse mass within cohort

mousePca.centroidWeighting: all tiles within a mouse; downstream summaries compare mice equally

comparabilityContract.combinedInference: exact cohort-blocked 6x6 permutation; equal cohort weight
comparabilityContract.rule: compare only identical metric and explicit population/aggregation estimands

limitations: Group 1 and Group 2 Rescanned are independent cluster fits; C# values are never aligned by number.
Combined-run C# values are a third, joint-run-local vocabulary and do not inherit either cohort's identities.
Mouse/WSI is the experimental unit; tile predictions are descriptive summaries only.
Cohort, cell line, processing batch and inference backend are fully confounded.
No batch correction was performed or is claimed.
Combined treatment inference uses equal-cohort blocked 36-permutation estimates only; pooled 4-vs-4 is not performed.

semanticAmendment.emergent_endpoint_withheld_reason: treatment-emergent contract requires observed-zero Vehicle rows in every Vehicle mouse; M368 has one C2 tile
semanticAmendment.trigger: The neutral technical review placed C2 under the pale_low_cellularity role, which the default gate excludes from every treatment-facing estimand. After the blinded run was frozen, the study owner reviewed the per-mouse composition and directed that C2 be treated as the same treatment-emergent injury compartment already recognised in the archived Group 2 run.

semanticReviewProvenance.interpretation: Group 2 Rescanned treatment-emergent semantics come from the cohort's own arm/outcome-blinded semantic review and remain provisional pending pathologist review.
